given_when_then.given: A Delivery Proof has been successfully recorded for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system calculates the settlement amounts against the Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record and flags it for manual review if the calculated amounts deviate from expected thresholds based on historical data

given_when_then.given: The sum of all calculated distributed amounts equals the total value of the Financial Transaction Record
given_when_then.when: The system validates the calculated settlement amounts
given_when_then.then: The system checks for deviations against historical thresholds; if a deviation exists, the transaction is flagged for manual review

given_when_then.given: A Financial Transaction Record exists for a completed delivery
given_when_then.when: The system processes the transaction based on historical data thresholds
given_when_then.then: The system flags the transaction for manual review if the calculated amounts deviate from expected thresholds

success_criteria: The system flags the Financial Transaction Record for manual review when calculated settlement amounts deviate from expected historical thresholds
The system generates a Financial Transaction Record for every completed delivery regardless of the outcome of the amount deviation check
The sum of distributed amounts in the Financial Transaction Record strictly equals the total value of the transaction
